assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: The 15 most intense ions were sequentially isolated and fragmented in the linear ion trap using collision-induced dissociation
Precursor ions were acquired in the mass range from m/z 300 to 2000 in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
quantification: The iBAQ algorithm was enabled to estimate quantitative values
enrichment: GFP proteins were immunoprecipitated using GFP-Trap agarose beads
experimentTypes: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
workflow_hints: Oxidation of methionine, phosphorylation of serine, threonine and tyrosine, methylation on lysine and arginine residues, acetylation of lysine and the protein N-terminus were specified as variable modifications.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using GFP-tagged DLC1 as bait. While the study focuses on ubiquitination, the MS analysis itself was performed on the total protein eluate from the AP, not on a diGly-enriched fraction (the ubiquitination results were primarily validated via Western Blot/Ni-NTA pulldown).

scope: GFP proteins were immunoprecipitated using GFP-Trap agarose beads (Chromotek, Martinsried, Germany).

GFP-tagged wild-type DLC1 was transiently expressed in MCF7 cells and immunopurified from cell lysates, followed by analysis of the samples by nano-liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (nanoLC-MS/MS).
